newsitem.title: FRANCE: French business sees stronger activity - BoF survey.
newsitem.headline: French business sees stronger activity - BoF survey.

text.p: Industrial activity is expected to show more sustained growth in most sectors in the coming months in France, the Bank of France said on Thursday, on the basis of a survey it carried out in November.
"The biggest gains are expected in the capital goods, consumer goods and intermediate goods sectors," the central bank said in a statement on the survey.
It said November capacity utilisation rates remained virtually unchanged. Retail sales in November posted a significant recovery after falling in Ovtober, the Bank added.
